title: Adapted complex polarizations on solvable Lie groups of dimension 3
summary: In this paper we investigate adapted complex polarizations associated with left-invariant Koszul connections on real Lie groups. Adapted complex polarizations arise as a natural generalization of a complex structure on a manifold. We investigate the existence of such polarizations on the tangent bundle of certain Lie groups with left-invariant connections. We use a practical criterion for the existence of global adapted complex polarizations in terms of the $i\mathbb R$-completeness of the geodesic flow of the connection.
